title: Measured sound pass
what_it_does: Script that takes a silent MP4 and a cue list, checks the music beat grid against kick drums, places one real effect per cue, mixes to -16 LUFS with true peak below -4 dBFS measured on the exported file, and writes CREDITS.txt and checks.
when_to_use: Sound design pass after the render.
why: Good method (credit to Vox @Voxyz_ai in the file) but overlaps our beat-grid scorer and hyperframes `audio`/`beats`/`normalize-audio`. Take the licence-check and measure-the-MP4 rules, not the script.
